summary.text: Ronald McCoy is the Independent Party candidate for Washington State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Shelly Short (R).

paragraphs.text: McCoy ran in the 2024 nonpartisan primary for Washington House of Representatives District 7-Position 2, where he was listed as a Republican and received 13.7 percent of the vote; Hunter Abell and Paul Dean advanced to the general election.
In the August 4, 2026 primary for State Senate District 7, McCoy received 27.7 percent of the vote (6,191 votes) and advanced to the general election along with Short, who received 58.0 percent.
